note: verdicts recomputed with the two-sided power rule; the one-sided rule in the run manifests printed NO POWER and was wrong
metric: mean absolute luminance change between adjacent frames of an identical 90-frame walk
caveat: shadowing darkens the ground and a darker image has smaller ABSOLUTE luminance deltas, so the magnitude of the reduction is confounded with darkening; the direction is what supports the negative claim, since flicker would push this UP
